hero.h1: Faucet Repair and Installation in Lincoln Park, Chicago
hero.sub: A dripping kitchen faucet, a bathroom faucet that won't shut off or new fixtures for a renovation. We repair and install faucets and fixtures in Lincoln Park homes and condos. Our office is on Diversey Parkway.

blocks.h2: When to Call About a Faucet

tiles.body: A clogged aerator or old pipe.

bodies: We repair and install kitchen faucets of every style, from classic bridge faucets in older homes to pull-down models in new kitchens.
We replace shutoffs and supply lines at the same time when they're worn.
We handle drains, shutoffs, dishwasher hookups, ice maker lines and [garbage disposals](/chicago-lincoln-park/garbage-disposal-installation-repair).
Renovating a condo kitchen? We'll coordinate the plumbing with your contractor and any building rules.

img.alt: Plumbing under a double kitchen sink: white PVC drain and P-trap, braided supply lines with chrome shutoff valves, and a garbage disposal

bodies: We install sinks, faucets, toilets and showerheads and check the shutoffs and supply lines while we're there.
Several fixtures to replace? We'll plan it for one visit when possible.

blocks.h2: Faucets and Fixtures in Lincoln Park Homes
blocks.intro: New fixtures often sit on old plumbing here.

items.body: We replace them when we replace the faucet.
Compact fixtures fit tight city baths.
Some buildings require shutoffs in specific places or scheduled work hours.

blocks.h2: What Happens When You Call J. Blanton

img.alt: J. Blanton plumber in shoe covers on a home's front steps with a sewer camera

blocks.h2: Fixtures for a Lincoln Park Renovation
blocks.body: Renovating a kitchen or bath in an older Lincoln Park building often means new fixtures on old supply pipes and drains. Before installing, we check the shutoffs, the supply lines and the drain behind the wall. In condo buildings, we follow the association's work hours and insurance requirements. You get fixtures that work well and a clean connection to the building's plumbing.

blocks.h2: Faucet Questions From Lincoln Park Homeowners

items.q: Can you install fixtures I bought for my renovation?
items.answer: Yes, as long as they're complete and suited to the space.

items.q: Do you work within condo building rules?
items.answer: Yes. We'll schedule during allowed hours and follow building requirements.

items.q: Should I replace my shutoff valves?
items.answer: If they're original or stiff, yes. It's easiest while the faucet is off.

items.q: Why is my faucet's flow weak?
items.preview: A clogged aerator or old pipe.
items.answer: Usually a clogged aerator. In older buildings, old supply pipe can also restrict flow.

items.q: Can you match the finish on all fixtures?
items.answer: We install what you choose and can suggest lines with matching finishes.

items.q: How much does faucet repair cost in Lincoln Park?
items.preview: It depends on the faucet. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the faucet and what's wrong. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
